prompt: Draft an email apologizing for sending an outdated event flyer. Clearly state that the correct start time is 3 p.m., and that the location has not changed. Please answer in roughly 160 words.
text:
Subject: Correction: Updated Event Flyer

Dear [Name],

I apologize for sending an outdated version of the event flyer. I understand that accurate event details are important, and I’m sorry for any confusion this may have caused.

Please note that the correct event start time is **3:00 p.m.** The location has **not changed** and remains as listed on the original flyer: [Location].

An updated flyer with the corrected start time will be shared shortly. Please disregard the previous version and use the updated information when making your plans or sharing details with others.

Thank you for your understanding, and again, I apologize for the error. We look forward to seeing you at the event and appreciate your continued support.

Best regards,  
[Your Name]
